name.en: Signal key over a time range

description.zh: 读取一个设备的一个信号键在指定时间段内的原始值，按时间排序。
description.en: Reads raw values of one device key within a time range, ordered by time.

description.zh: 从上次读取的时间点之后继续读取，用于定时同步。
description.en: Continues after the last timestamp read; used for scheduled sync.

template_sql.telemetry-by-key-range:
SELECT deviceid, keyname, ts, value_double
FROM telemetry
WHERE deviceid = :device_id AND keyname = :key_name
  AND ts >= :start AND ts < :end
ORDER BY ts
LIMIT 200000
template_sql.telemetry-incremental:
SELECT deviceid, keyname, ts, value_double
FROM telemetry
WHERE deviceid = :device_id AND keyname = :key_name
  AND ts > :watermark
ORDER BY ts
LIMIT 50000
